Title: Cleaning up of Annex K Reason for change: There are some mistakes remaining in Annex K. Summary of change: Removing the Editor’s note under title of Annex K limiting applicability to only single carrier test cases as the principle of applying to CA test cases has already been added in K.1. Moving the definition of BEAM_SELECT_WAIT_TIME under title of Annex K as this is used through the whole section. Cleaning up the null pointer of ‘NOTE 1’ wherever BEAM_SELECT_WAIT_TIME is used. Correcting the reference of Alignment Option from J.* to N.* In K.1.1 adding a step to measure ERIP with PolLink=. In K.1.7, correcting steps 3 and 4 to align with other subsections. In K.1.3 and K.1.7, adding step of deactivating UBF. Consequences if not approved: The procedures are not correct. Clauses affected: Annex K

ing type A performance – rank1 baseline receiver for both SA and NSA Proposal 2: Specify SA and NSA in the test case title to clearly identify test cases which are applicable for both SA and NSA. Within the anchor agnostic test cases, there would be some differences in the way a certain initial condition step or test procedure step for SA or NSA is handled. For example, generic procedure parameters for ensuring UE is in RRC_CONNECTED mode is different for SA and NSA. Since the expected change in the initial condition step or test procedure step is not significatntly different, include the variation in the wordings within the test step itself instead of separating into 2 subsections. Example is given below.
...
As outlined in [3], section 5-8 of demod spec assumes same requirements for SA and NSA modes. For NSA, only NR requirements would be defined. Since the same test case is applicable to both SA and NSA mode, we prefer to clearly specify in the test case title that the test case is applicable for both SA and NSA. Proposal1: Split the PDSCH demod performance test sections per MIMO config and UE receiver type. Proposal 2: Specify SA and NSA in the test case title to clearly identify test cases which are applicable for both SA and NSA. Proposal 3: Include SA and NSA specific wordings within the initial condition step or test procedure step Proposal 4: Include separate subsections within the message contents section to account for SA and NSA specify message contents. Proposal 5: Specify all LTE link related setup details, parameters in a separate Annex and refer to that annex within the initial conditions section of the test case. Proposal 6: Request RAN4 to add ChBW/SCS fields in the min requirements table instead of test parameter table. Proposal 7: Request RAN4 to add TCI state and QCL fields in the test parameter table
